import json
n=19
centers=[(3,6,8),(4,13,4),(12,14,1),(14,3,2)]
g=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
for r,c,v in centers:
 g[r][c]=v
 for rr,cc in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)): g[rr][cc]=3
orig=[row[:] for row in g]
# Paint horizontal rays into blank cells, then vertical rays into blanks or prior lines.
for r,c,v in centers:
 for j in range(n):
  if orig[r][j]==0: g[r][j]=v
for r,c,v in centers:
 for i in range(n):
  if orig[i][c]==0: g[i][c]=v
assert all(len(row)==19 for row in g)
print(json.dumps({'action':'submit','grid':g},separators=(',',':')))

import json
n=19
centers=[(3,6,8),(4,13,4),(12,14,1),(14,3,2)]
hollow=(10,8)
g=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
for r,c,v in centers:
 g[r][c]=v
 for rr,cc in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)): g[rr][cc]=3
hr,hc=hollow
for rr,cc in ((hr-1,hc),(hr+1,hc),(hr,hc-1),(hr,hc+1)): g[rr][cc]=3
orig=[row[:] for row in g]
# Each colored cross extends its color over its full row and column, but leave the row/column of the uncolored cross unpainted; retain all original motif cells.
for r,c,v in centers:
 for j in range(n):
  if orig[r][j]==0 and r!=hr and j!=hc: g[r][j]=v
for r,c,v in centers:
 for i in range(n):
  if orig[i][c]==0 and i!=hr and c!=hc: g[i][c]=v
assert len(g)==19 and all(len(row)==19 for row in g)
print(json.dumps({'action':'submit','grid':g},separators=(',',':')))

import json
n=19
centers=[(3,6,8),(4,13,4),(12,14,1),(14,3,2)]
# reconstruct original crosses
orig=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
objects=[]
for r,c,v in centers:
 cells={(r,c),(r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)}
 objects.append((r,c,v,cells))
 for i,j in cells: orig[i][j]=v if (i,j)==(r,c) else 3
# uncolored plus at (10,8)
r,c=10,8
blankcells={(r,c),(r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)}
for i,j in blankcells:orig[i][j]=0 if (i,j)==(r,c) else 3
# Ray cast: own arms are transparent; all foreign motif cells block. Vertical rays are overlaid after horizontal rays.
h=[[None]*n for _ in range(n)]; vmat=[[None]*n for _ in range(n)]
for r,c,col,cells in objects:
 for dr,dc,out in ((0,-1,h),(0,1,h),(-1,0,vmat),(1,0,vmat)):
  i,j=r+dr,c+dc
  while 0<=i<n and 0<=j<n:
   if (i,j) not in cells and orig[i][j]!=0: break
   if orig[i][j]==0: out[i][j]=col
   i+=dr;j+=dc
g=[row[:] for row in orig]
for i in range(n):
 for j in range(n):
  if h[i][j] is not None:g[i][j]=h[i][j]
  if vmat[i][j] is not None:g[i][j]=vmat[i][j]
assert len(g)==19 and all(len(row)==19 for row in g)
print(json.dumps({'action':'submit','grid':g},separators=(',',':')))
